description: Two-Tier Universal Reference Anchor Standards Registry. Tier 1A covers invariant building-code & manufacturing axes; Tier 1B covers widespread manufactured consumer/office objects; Tier 1C covers architectural elements with known regional variance (down-weighted unless corroborated).

us_wall_outlet_plate.display_name: US NEMA Wall Outlet / Switch Plate
us_wall_outlet_plate.notes: Height is strictly 4.5 in across 1-gang, 2-gang, and 3-gang standard NEMA wall plates; always prefer height over width on multi-gang plates.

us_multigang_switch_plate.notes: Use height_in=4.5 strictly; width scales with gang count (2-gang=4.56 in, 3-gang=6.38 in).

eu_uk_wall_socket.display_name: EU Type F / UK BS 1363 Single Wall Socket

us_interior_door.notes: Standard 6 ft 8 in (80.0 in) residential/office door leaf height; width varies (28-36 in) so prefer full height when top & bottom of door are visible.

acoustic_ceiling_tile_2x2.notes: Standard 24 in x 24 in T-bar grid module.

cmu_cinder_block.notes: Nominal 8 in H x 16 in W including 3/8 in mortar joint.

us_letter_paper.notes: WARNING: Paper lying flat on desks/trays suffers severe perspective foreshortening. Down-weighted unless mounted vertically flat on a wall.

standard_desk_table_height.display_name: Standard Fixed Desk / Dining Table Height
standard_desk_table_height.notes: ANSI/BIFMA standard fixed work surface height (29.0-30.0 in). Down-weight if standing desk is raised.

macbook_14_laptop.notes: MacBook Air 13 / Pro 14 chassis width (11.97 - 12.31 in).

monitor_27_16x9.notes: 27-inch 16:9 bezel-less panel width ~24.1 in, height ~13.8 in.

modern_baseboard.notes: HIGH VARIANCE WARNING: Modern drywall trim is 3.5-4.25 in, whereas pre-war NYC/historic trim is 5.5-8.0 in. Never override a Tier 1A/1B anchor with baseboard alone.
